newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe education minister resigns over leak.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe education minister resigns over leak.

text.p: Zimbabwe's Education Minister Edmund Garwe resigned on Thursday after admitting his daughter leaked an examination paper at her school, state radio reported.
The Zimbabwe Broadcasting Corporation quoted Garwe as saying President Robert Mugabe had accepted his resignation. The minister and his officials were unavailable for comment.
On Wednesday, Garwe told reporters his daughter, a student at a private school in Harare, got hold of the paper after he had left it lying around at home.
"I have no excuse for this. It should never have happened and I am very sorry about it," Garwe said.
In the past two years Zimbabwean schools have had a problem with leakages of examination papers and Garwe has been vowing to deal harshly with the culprits.
